_comment: MEADOWS-VISUAL-PASS round 5. The Meadows realm's own look, deep-merged over data/config/art.json by world_look.gd (realm_look_path on the Meadows WorldLook). art.json's presets are shared by every realm; what only the Meadows wants lives here.
_comment_environment: Distance haze. art.json's shared #a6bccb at 0.00055 turned the far plain into a white band under every elevated Meadows view (survey 03: a 'white fog wall'); a bluer, lighter haze keeps the depth cue while the hills and groves still read at a kilometre. Golden, dawn and night keep their own preset fog, which overrides this base. TUNABLE.

look_candidate.scope: Local Meadows presentation only; no durable or replicated state. Requires matched Medium/High three-judge Bar A >=8.5 before enabling.

environment._comment_night_fill: F38 candidate: turn18 blind judges could not read the route or trainer legs at night, including Ironwood rain. Strengthen the existing cool ambient fill and reduce its dark-sky share; retain the night sky, exposure and weather response. Requires the fixed Medium/High visual proof before activation.

_why_f04_6_r29: Environment grade (haze #9cb7d3 at 0.001, contrast 1.1, saturation 1.08) and the warm 38-degree sun: ON (CPU-provisional improvement, not a closure): F04#6 r29 mapped 6.38 Bar A vs shipping 5.91 with three code-blind judges on the fixed F04-6 camera set (Low/Compatibility, llvmpipe; ralph/reports/LOOK/close-1022/F04-6.md). Parked by the gain rule; a GPU pass decides, and a GPU score below the bar reopens it.

light_candidate._why: Group 3 (vis-meadows, 1 Nov, OFF until GPU-judged): the batch-1 judges' ask common to every Meadows stand, 'flat midday light and crushed night frames; a warm key light with rim, aerial fog, and night fill so subjects read'. meadows_look.gd::light_candidate_look merges `look` over art.json + this file for the Meadows rig only. Day: the key sun turns warmer and a little lower (-38 -> -33 deg, 1.5 -> 1.65, #ffe8c4 -> #ffdfb4) for longer modelling shadows; characters get a soft rim (player_character_rim_scale 0 -> 0.35); aerial fog roughly doubles (0.001 -> 0.0019, fog_sky_affect 0 -> 0.3, aerial_perspective 0.7 -> 0.9) so the distance layers into blue haze. Night: more fill so bodies read (ambient 1.5 -> 1.95, exposure 1.2 -> 1.35, moon 0.55 -> 0.72, shadow opacity 0.68 -> 0.58), and a tighter moon glow (sun_glow 0.15 -> 0.07, falloff 55 -> 95) for the banded halo the P2-003 judges named. Golden keeps its own block. Presentation only.

cause_light._why: Cause lane tb/cause-meadows (1 Nov, OFF until GPU-judged). One biome light/grade pass for the judges' shared Meadows causes: 'flat midday light with almost no atmospheric depth', 'no value range', 'creatures don't separate from the grass'. Supersedes light_candidate (its night block is carried here unchanged, so enabling both is harmless). Day: a warmer, lower key (pitch -38 -> -30, 1.5 -> 1.75, #ffe8c4 -> #ffd7a3) against a cooler, weaker ambient fill (1.9 -> 1.3, #9db3c6 -> #8aa3c6) so lit faces are warm and shadows are cool and darker; exposure 0.6 -> 0.62 keeps the mean. Distance: fog about x2.2 and bluer (#9cb7d3 0.001 -> #94b0d2 0.0022), a little sky affect (0.15) and aerial perspective 0.9, the sky horizon and haze matched to the fog (EV8 invariant), the terrain's own distance fade colour cooler (#7f8c9e -> #7088ae). Grade: contrast 1.1 -> 1.16, saturation 1.08 -> 1.0 (the acid green). Separation: a character rim by day (player_character_rim_scale 0 -> 0.4) and a creature field-rim floor (creature_field_rim_floor 0.12: every common creature gets a faint silhouette rim; under the uncommon tier's 0.14 and the alpha's 0.65 so the rarity tells stay). Golden keeps its own block. Presentation only; no durable state; nothing per frame; renderer-neutral (fog, ambient, sun, rim and ACES all exist on Compatibility).

cause_ground._why: Cause lane tb/cause-meadows (1 Nov, OFF until GPU-judged). One Meadows ground pass for the judges' shared causes: 'uniform dark-green grass carpet', 'smeared, low-resolution ground textures' (terrain and village alike). Readers: playground_world.gd::_apply_ground_shader merges `terrain_shader` over terrain_presentation.json (after its shader_candidate); grass_field.gd::config merges `grass` (same merge/tiers shape as meadows_ground_candidate, applied after it); meadows_look.gd applies `viewport` to the Meadows viewport and restores the previous values when the Meadows look leaves the tree. Terrain: the macro blobs become a deliberate two-tone (light straw / cooler, darker lush green) instead of an olive smear, the terrain mip bias sharpens (0.86 -> 0.7) and near grain strengthens (0.22 -> 0.34). Grass ring: the ground-zone field at full strength and a larger scale (~31 m) so a frame reads as clearings (zone_bare ~14%), lawn, tall grass and dry-olive patches instead of one carpet; deeper clump contrast (0.55 -> 0.75) for a value range inside the grass; the two flower tiers gather into denser drifts with open grass between. Viewport: 16x anisotropic filtering and a -0.35 texture mip bias so ground and village textures stay crisp at grazing angles. Runtime only: no bake, terrain height, collision or scatter change; no per-frame work.
